items.question: What range of fines does the UAE federal law on mental health impose on offenders of its regulations?
items.gold: Fines ranging from AED 50,000 to AED 200,000, along with imprisonment.
items.fact: Mental health law fines range AED 50,000 to 200,000

items.question: How many main strategic objectives does the UAE's National Policy for the Promotion of Mental Health identify?
items.fact: National Mental Health Policy identifies five strategic objectives
